scenario: [LGRA.5.8.6]: a `Json` value of exactly the node limit, 256, is admitted when the host asserts it into a `Json` slot. The value is one array holding fifteen arrays of sixteen Ints: 1 + 15 + 240 = 256, since every scalar, array and object counts, the root included. The fact lands (fact_count 1). Paired with LGRA.5.8.6_host_nodes_over_limit, the same value with one more Int and refused, so a limit of 255 (this vector goes red) or 257 (the other goes red) is caught. PATH PINNED: on libds, libds's builders as pyds's `pyds_py_to_json_tree_at` calls them (`ds_json_array_append` counts the nodes); on the Mercury runtime, `ds.engine.host_assert` through `ds.fact`'s `sr_json_limit` check (`ds.json.limit_breach`).
